Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer
Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator, an Indian street food vendor simulation game developed by Chameleon 42 Games. Players will take to the streets of India to serve the public and assemble intricate dishes, all in the name of saving their beloved. Chop up ingredients, cook up popular food, and excel in mini-games. Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam).

Carnival Hunt - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
Carnival Hunt is out now in Early Access on PC. Watch the creepy Carnival Hunt early access launch trailer for this 5v1 first-person asymmetrical horror game. Five wind-up Bunnies must work together, manage their noisy keys, and find a way to escape an ever-changing carnival world while one player hunts them as the Carnival Monster.

Starsand Island - Official Release Date Trailer
Take a look at the release date trailer for Starsand Island, a life simulation RPG developed by Seed Sparkle Lab. Players will live out the calm country life in Starsand Island, explore the sights, create relationships, and engage in a variety of activities, such as home building, decorating, seasonal festivals, cooking, and more. Starsand Island is launching on August 18 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

text:
Marvel Is Setting Up A Comics Inaccurate X-Men Team (And That's Great News)
It's been clear for some time that Marvel's next big phase will focus around mutants. Having been teased for the last few years since Disney bought Fox and the X-Men and Fantastic Four along with it, it's only been a matter of time before Xavier's School For Gifted Youngsters would pop up in the MCU. And while it hasn't officially gotten there yet, Marvel and Kevin Feige have taken one big step closer to unveiling their X-Men, although it won't be a team quite like any we've seen before. Here's the latest clues as to where they're headed with mutants, and why a not comics-accurate team is the best decision they could make.

Batman: Caped Crusader Chronicles - Official Launch Trailer
Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles is available now on Amazon Luna. Watch the Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles launch trailer for this 1–4 player cooperative detective adventure game for a peek at what to expect. In Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles, become members of a special GCPD task force working alongside Batman and Detective Montoya to crack the cases and save the city. Team up with up to three friends to investigate 11 episodic cases, uncover clues through unique detective-themed minigames, and bring notorious villains like Scarecrow, Babyface, and The Joker to justice.
